run_display_model_cli: run the display_model CLI to inspect a ParlAI diplomacy model's architecture and parameters
run_register_all_agents: run register_all_agents to load all diplomacy agents including generator, classifier, and prefix models
run_register_all_tasks: run register_all_tasks to load all diplomacy tasks including dialogue, order, and classifier tasks
run_setup_args: run setup_args to create an argument parser for displaying a ParlAI diplomacy model
run_display_model: run display_model with parsed options to print model details to the console
